text.name: Radiant Tsareena

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Elegant Heal
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may heal 20 damage from each of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Aroma Shot
attacks.text: This Pokémon recovers from all Special Conditions.

rules.label: Radiant Pokémon Rule
rules.text: You can't have more than 1 Radiant Pokémon in your deck.

text.flavor: This feared Pokémon has long, slender legs and a cruel heart. It shows no mercy as it stomps on its opponents.

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Luminous Sign
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may search your deck for a Supporter card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Aqua Return
attacks.text: Shuffle this Pokémon and all attached cards into your deck.

rules.label: V rule
rules.text: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Kinda Lazy
abilities.text: If you have exactly 2, 4, or 6 Prize cards remaining, this Pokémon can't attack.

rules.label: V rule
rules.text: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

text.name: Pumpkaboo

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Pumpkin Pit
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may discard a Stadium in play.

text.flavor: The light that streams out from the holes in the pumpkin can hypnotize and control the people and Pokémon that see it.

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Wild Style
abilities.text: This Pokémon's attacks cost {Colorless} less for each of your opponent's Single Strike, Rapid Strike, and Fusion Strike Pokémon in play.

attacks.name: Dynamic Tail
attacks.text: This attack also does 60 damage to 1 of your Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

rules.label: V rule
rules.text: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Frontier Road
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when this Pokémon moves from your Bench to the Active Spot, you may move any amount of Energy from your other Pokémon to it.

attacks.name: Psyshield Bash
attacks.text: This attack does 40 damage for each Energy attached to this Pokémon.

rules.label: V rule
rules.text: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

text.name: Collapsed Stadium
effect: Each player can't have more than 4 Benched Pokémon. If a player has 5 or more Benched Pokémon, they discard Benched Pokémon until they have 4 Pokémon on the Bench. The player who played this card discards first. If more than one effect changes the number of Benched Pokémon allowed, use the smaller number.

rules.text: This Stadium stays in play when you play it. Discard it if another Stadium comes into play. If a Stadium with the same name is in play, you can't play this card.

attacks.name: Read the Wind
attacks.text: Discard a card from your hand. If you do, draw 3 cards.

attacks.name: Aero Dive
attacks.text: You may discard a Stadium in play.

rules.label: V rule
rules.text: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.label: VSTAR Power
abilities.name: Summoning Star
abilities.text: During your turn, you may put up to 2 {Colorless} Pokémon that don't have a Rule Box from your discard pile onto your Bench. (Pokémon V, Pokémon-GX, etc. have Rule Boxes.) (You can't use more than 1 VSTAR Power in a game.)

attacks.name: Tempest Dive
attacks.text: You may discard a Stadium in play.

rules.label: VSTAR rule
rules.text: When your Pokémon VSTAR is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

text.name: Snorlax

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Unfazed Fat
abilities.text: Prevent all effects of attacks from your opponent's Pokémon done to this Pokémon. (Damage is not an effect.)

attacks.name: Thumping Snore
attacks.text: This Pokémon is now Asleep. During Pokémon Checkup, flip 2 coins instead of 1. If either of them is tails, this Pokémon is still Asleep.

text.flavor: It is not satisfied unless it eats over 880 pounds of food every day. When it is done eating, it goes promptly to sleep.

text.name: Archeops

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Primal Turbo
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may search your deck for up to 2 Special Energy cards and attach them to 1 of your Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

text.flavor: It needs a running start to take off. If Archeops wants to fly, it first needs to run nearly 25 mph, building speed over a course of about 2.5 miles.

text.name: Path to the Peak
effect: Pokémon with a Rule Box in play (both yours and your opponent's) have no Abilities. (Pokémon V, Pokémon-GX, etc. have Rule Boxes.)

rules.text: This Stadium stays in play when you play it. Discard it if another Stadium comes into play. If a Stadium with the same name is in play, you can't play this card.

text.name: Double Turbo Energy
effect: As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides {Colorless}{Colorless} Energy.
The attacks of the Pokémon this card is attached to do 20 less damage to your opponent's Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

text.name: Capturing Aroma
effect: Flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for an Evolution Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. If tails, search your deck for a Basic Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

rules.text: You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

text.name: V Guard Energy
effect: As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides {Colorless} Energy.

The Pokémon this card is attached to takes 30 less damage from attacks from your opponent's Pokémon V (after applying Weakness and Resistance). This effect can't be applied more than once at a time to the same Pokémon.

text.name: Gift Energy
effect: As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides {Colorless} Energy.
If the Pokémon this card is attached to is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent's Pokémon, draw cards until you have 7 cards in your hand.

text.name: Boss's Orders
effect: Switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot.

rules.text: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

text.name: Choice Belt
effect: The attacks of the Pokémon this card is attached to do 30 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon V (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

rules.text: You may attach any number of Pokémon Tools to your Pokémon during your turn. You may attach only 1 Pokémon Tool to each Pokémon, and it stays attached.

text.name: Nest Ball
effect: Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

rules.text: You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

text.name: Iono
effect: Each player shuffles their hand and puts it on the bottom of their deck. If either player put any cards on the bottom of their deck in this way, each player draws a card for each of their remaining Prize cards.

rules.text: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

text.name: Jet Energy
effect: As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides {Colorless} Energy.
When you attach this card from your hand to 1 of your Benched Pokémon, switch that Pokémon with your Active Pokémon.

text.name: Professor's Research
effect: Discard your hand and draw 7 cards.

rules.text: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

text.name: Therapeutic Energy
effect: As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides {Colorless} Energy.
The Pokémon this card is attached to recovers from being Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed and can't be affected by those Special Conditions.

text.name: Ultra Ball
effect: You can use this card only if you discard 2 other cards from your hand.
Search your deck for a Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

rules.text: You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

text.name: Professor Burnet
effect: Search your deck for up to 2 cards and discard them. Then, shuffle your deck.

rules.text: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.
